intent: Eight individual indefinite-pronoun tasks preserve each-person allocation, all/unknown/none scope, reason knowledge, restrictions, exceptions and needed-item range.
picturePurpose: Exact coded three-person allocations teach one item per person without mistaking a group total for individual coverage. No generated image is treated as proof of an unknown sound source or past knowledge.

transfer.stem: Which summary preserves the picnic notes?
transfer.passage:
Checking the picnic notes
Our club compared statements before a picnic. “Everyone brought one item” meant one item per person, not one item for the whole group. In a separate three-person practice task, a total of three was not enough: each person had to have exactly one.
Everybody waited until the smallest child was ready. We kept both the full group and that time boundary. Somebody had left a light on upstairs; this stated that a person had done it, without naming the person. Nobody knew why a bell had stopped. That was a lack of knowledge about the reason, not a claim that nobody knew the bell had stopped.
Something was rattling inside a box. We did not guess its identity or an exact number of objects from that statement. A sign said not to touch anything behind a barrier. The restriction covered any object behind the barrier; it did not say all objects everywhere.
Outside, nothing moved except the leaves. The leaves were the exception: they moved while nothing else did. Everything we needed fit in one bag. That covered the things we needed, not every possession we owned; it did not confirm that we had already packed them.

options.text: One item per person; nobody knew the reason; the leaves moved while nothing else did.
One item for the whole group; nobody knew the reason; the leaves moved while nothing else did.
One item per person; nobody knew the bell had stopped; the leaves moved while nothing else did.
One item per person; nobody knew the reason; not even the leaves moved.

answer.display: One item per person; nobody knew the reason; the leaves moved while nothing else did.
